items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: Well, he's a trumpet player. I played a couple of engagements with him.

ctx.x: Well, he's a trumpet player. I played a couple of engagements with him. They sent for him to come to New York and play one gig at the Army Club there on 52nd Street. And I played one, no, we did a recording down in New Jersey; and he's playing behind a crate too loud, pushing him further too loud; ... drunk, back ... He was old. He was way up in his 70s when he passed.
But, you didn't know him earlier?
